integrity: Analytical pathwise proof and maximal martingale bound; exact tests support finite instances only. Related literature inspected with residual uncertainty; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed activity probability; no sharp constant, no convergence rate to Poisson–Dirichlet. Strict records with final censored gap. Non-lazy limit depends on a separately published theorem.
title: A quantitative all-ranks record-age time-change principle for lazy random walks
